common: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one transparent pixel-art sprite for a tiny first-person dungeon crawler, in the style of Eye of the Beholder and Dungeon Master. ONE isolated object, genuine transparent alpha, no wall, no background, no floor, no shadow, no border, no labels or text. Draw at the stated tiny logical resolution enlarged with hard square pixels, chunky clusters, bold readable silhouette and restrained shading; no fine noise, smooth painting or antialiasing. Dark black-paper dungeon aesthetic, warm light from above and toward the viewer. Nonemissive palette: charcoal #0b0a08 #151614 #322b2b, gray iron #3d3a36 #515349 #63655c #7a7c72 #94968c #b0b2a8, dark wood #1a0e07 #331a0c #452712 #582b13 #684629 #784620 #924f1d #a97639. Real flames alone may use #431e0f #7a4a12 #a8341f #ecb64a #f6b450 #f7ca58 #fbd070. No white, neon, blue steel or decorative glow.

sprites.chest_open: Logical canvas 20x16, landscape. Input image 1 is the edit target: the existing closed treasure chest. Make its OPEN animation frame. Keep the lower body, base, center latch, two vertical iron straps and bottom silhouette in exactly the same position, size and colors. Change only the upper lid and contents. Throw the lid back and UP so its dark inner wooden face and two iron bands stand almost upright at the top of the canvas. The open dark cavity and a low heap of golden coins with one small teal gem must be clearly visible above the original front rim. Gold may use #ecb64a #f6b450 #f7ca58 #fbd070 and #c7b48f glints; the gem uses only #50c6b3. Front-on and slightly above, same viewpoint as reference. Lower front remains below logical y8; raised lid around y0..4; gold and gem around y5..7; preserve the base and straps below y8. No coins spilling outside, no extra props. Whole chest fits the exact same 20x16 transparent canvas.
sprites.sconce_a: Logical canvas 12x20, portrait. A medieval iron WALL SCONCE holding one burning torch, viewed front-on as it hangs on a castle dungeon wall. Iron bracket at the bottom: a small vertical mounting plate and a clearly bent projecting support arm with a socket. A short dark wooden torch shaft slants slightly UP and OUT toward the right from the socket, topped by a soot-dark wrapped torch head and lively pointed flame. Logical placement: gray mounting plate x3..5 y12..18, bent bracket reaches x8 around y15, wooden torch slopes from x6 y14 to x8 y9, flame centered x7 around y4 with tips in y1..8. Flame has a broad gold core and darker red edges, 2 or 3 bold tongues, fire inks ONLY inside the flame. Gray highlights on the iron, brown on wood, no fire colors on bracket or shaft. Narrow transparent margin, the entire fixture is visible. No hand, no detached torch, no visible wall, no sparks or halo.
sprites.sconce_b: Logical canvas 12x20, portrait. Input image 1 is sconce_a, the edit target. Create ONLY its alternate flame flicker frame. Preserve the iron mounting plate, bent projecting bracket, socket, wooden shaft, soot-dark torch head, placement and all non-flame pixels exactly. Change only the flame: its upper tongue leans the other way and its gold core shifts, with a visibly different but similarly sized silhouette. Flame remains confined above the torch head in logical y1..8. Real flame colors only; no moving iron or wood, no sparks, no halo. Exact same 12x20 canvas and front-on wall-hung view.
sprites.banner: Logical canvas 12x24, tall portrait. One old hanging CLOTH BANNER in a castle dungeon, front-on. A short dark iron horizontal hanging rod at the top and two attachment loops, then a broad faded brick-red fabric field. Red cloth is matte and NONEMISSIVE: use muted rusty red-brown #652c10 #582b13 #322b2b, restrained highlight #924f1d, not vivid fire red. One large PALE SWORD SIGIL centered on the cloth: straight light gray blade pointing upward, a wide horizontal crossguard and short handle below, simple bold shape readable at 12 pixels wide. Pale sigil #7a7c72 #94968c #b0b2a8, no white, no glints, no glow. Broad folds and a dark side seam, no tiny grain. Ragged bottom with two or three substantial uneven tears and pointed cloth remnants. Rod around y1, cloth x2..9 y3..22; maintain transparent margins and visible ragged silhouette. No letters, tassels, extra heraldic symbols, background or floor.

generation: Separate built-in image_gen calls; transparent_background=true. Concatenate common, newline, and the named sprites value.
